summary: Frontend-only click-through testing of ROYAL11 features: Live Score Ticker, Team Builder, Rewards Store, and cross-screen wallet state. All six requested scenarios PASSED end-to-end without refresh.

issues: Console warning from Lenis: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position, like relative/fixed/absolute...' — cosmetic, does not block UX but should be fixed by adding position:relative to the scroll wrapper.

action_items: (Optional) Fix Lenis smooth-scroll container warning by giving the scroll wrapper a non-static position.
critical_code_review_comments: WalletContext: joinContest uses stale `balance` in closure check (balance < fee). Because setBalance is functional but the read uses state directly, rapid successive calls could allow negative balances. Not user-reachable in current UI, but consider using a functional check.
RewardsStore.buy: uses `balance` from context for the 'insufficient' toast description — could be stale immediately after another purchase; acceptable for current UX.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 target scenarios verified in a single session (no reload): (1) Live ticker cricket card updates within ~6s (score 182/4 18.3 -> 183/4 18.5, note '37 off 9' -> '36 off 7'). (2) Team Builder: fantasy-join-btn opens modal; picking XI = [p16,p15,p14,p11,p7,p6,p10,p1,p2,p5,p13] totals 97 credits (credits-left 3/100); lock-lineup-btn disabled until 11 picked; 12th player (p3) becomes disabled correctly; locking closes modal + toast + home-balance 12,480 -> 12,380 (-100). (3) Rewards Store: redeem-btn opens modal; tabs avatar/badge/boost switch grids; buying bo3 Lucky Spin (150) marks Owned + disables button, wallet-balance 12,380 -> 12,230, stat-rewards 6 -> 7, txn 'Redeemed Lucky Spin -150' appended to txn-list. (4) Cross-screen state confirmed: wallet-balance == home-balance after actions. Insufficient-funds toast path not exercised because starting balance (12,480) exceeds all store item prices; consider seeding a lower balance to test that guard.
